_what: Confinement profile (ADR-0034 §1, ADR-0036 §1) for the compiled occupant: the trained SLM's Persona inside a static binary on an empty image, launched by the reference's launcher at rung 1. Written by slm/occupant/run_rung1.py with the measured digests. Not a corpus record.
_verdicts_are: ASSERTED by the launcher (ADR-0036 §1 R1, ADR-0034 §2): the launcher applies `launch`, appraises `image` and `persona`, and is trusted for the rest along with the host operator, the container runtime and Docker Desktop's VM (ADR-0036 §5).
_image: docker image inspect --format {{.Id}} topak-slm-occupant, built from slm/occupant/Dockerfile: FROM scratch, one statically linked binary at /occupant, USER 10001:10001.
_launch: Every field is one topak-contain's DockerLaunch applies; the launcher adds --rm -i --network none --log-driver none. No memory or CPU limit is listed because the launcher cannot apply one.

channel.kind: stdio, line-delimited JSON: topak-contain's guest protocol (hello, attest/evidence, granted, op/response, shutdown)
channel.token: None crosses the channel: the bridge is the session and the guest never holds a token (ADR-0036 §2)
channel.stderr: outward only, to the launcher's log; carries no protocol

P1.why: --network none; stdio is the only I/O the launcher connects. Stderr is outward-only and listed

P2.why: Read-only root, a 16 MB non-executable tmpfs, and the three bundle files read-only. Nothing else is mounted, not even the workspace: the guest reaches it only through Draft and Read

P3.why: The image is FROM scratch with one statically linked binary, /occupant, which is the occupant itself: no shell, no interpreter, no package manager, no dynamic loader. Its host-only transport, chosen by the launcher's arguments and never by Persona output, could start a named program, and the image holds none but the occupant

P4.why: The occupant's alphabet has no Invoke

P5.why: Weights and tokenizer are in the guest and inference runs in the occupant process; both are digest-checked against model.json before the identity line, and model.json's digest is a reference value the launcher appraises

P6.why: --rm; one launch per grant; the guest is destroyed at round end

P7.why: The image digest and the model.json digest. Changing either is a new profile
